_comment: A single-file class whose import binds `$guard`, named explicitly by every finding. `$` is a regex metacharacter and not a word character, so `\b$guard\b` neither escapes nor anchors — the seam read as unsubstantiated and the gate passed on a class the findings had named.

findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate `$guard` after the await**

`$guard` is read before the await and written after it, so a concurrent writer wins the race and nothing revalidates `$guard` in between.
